subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
RECIPIENT_NAME 您好，
再跟一下我之前那封为 {Brand} 优化到购买的邮件。最近这块格局在变：即时零售 2025 年预计同比增长 28.6%，规模到 1.003 万亿元，意向更碎、更看首单转化。而行业里安装到购买通常落在 1% 到 2% 之间，零售应用约 1.38%，所以把预算压在确认购买上才稳。我们会用留出组做增量检验，让付费带来的是净新增订单。要不要拿这套口径跟您现在的来源做个对照?
angle: fresh angle: timely China instant-retail 28.6% YoY surge (sourced) + install-to-purchase 1-2% benchmark band
register_notes: Stage 2 zh China ecommerce UA: references prior email in first sentence; fresh angle = timely sourced development (China instant retail +28.6% YoY to RMB 1.003 trillion in 2025, eMarketer) + real install-to-purchase benchmark band 1-2%, retail 1.38% (skailama/uxcam); MobUpps holdout/incrementality named with no figure; no new brands introduced; exactly 1 question mark; native Mandarin; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y; numbers are market context, not attributed to MobUpps.
